prompt: A horned fire demon with cracked obsidian-black skin glowing molten orange in the seams, caught at the instant of its own death: its body bursting apart in a violent outward blast of fire and embers, the explosion searing a cowering leather-armored bandit beside it who throws up an arm against the heat. Side three-quarter view, the demon detonating, arms flung wide. The only source of light is the eruption of flame. The background is a dark scorched battlefield at night with drifting ash.

A demon of living wildfire, its body made of crimson and orange flame over a charred skeletal frame with two curved horns, exploding at the moment of death into a radiating fan of fire that blasts toward a victim. The demon is hunched and rupturing, fire pouring outward from its chest. The only light is the firestorm of its dying body. The background is a ruined village street at night, embers raining down.

A demon of living wildfire, its body made of crimson and orange flame over a charred skeletal frame with two curved horns, exploding at the moment of death into a radiating fan of fire that blasts sideways toward a cowering leather-armored bandit who throws up both arms against the heat and is being burned. The demon is hunched and rupturing, fire pouring outward from its chest. The only light is the firestorm of its dying body. The background is a ruined village street at night, embers raining down.
